english.title: Cause wasteful employment of police
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused wasteful employment of the police by knowingly making to **(..SPECIFY NAME..) a false report

(A)_[tending to show that an offence had been committed]_
(B)_[to give rise to apprehension for the safety of persons or property]_
(C)_[tending to show that you had information material to a police enquiry]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(2) of the Criminal Law Act 1967.

english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - PND Code DA01.
(i) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required where a prosecution is sought.
(ii) DPP consent not required where a penalty notice for disorder is imposed but as above, would be for any subsequent prosecution.
(iii) The Penalty Notice for Disorder was raised from £80 to £90 as from 1/07/13

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Achosi i'r heddlu gael eu defnyddio'n wastraffus
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) bu i chi achosi i'r heddlu gael eu defnyddio'n wastraffus drwy roi adroddiad anwir yn fwriadol i **(..SPECIFY NAME..)

(A)_[a oedd yn tueddu i ddangos bod trosedd wedi'i gyflawni]_
(B)_[er mwyn i hynny arwain at arestio er mwyn diogelu unigolion neu eiddo]_
(C)_[a oedd yn tueddu i ddangos bod gennych wybodaeth a oedd yn bwysig i ymchwiliad heddlu]_
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 5(2) Deddf Cyfraith Trosedd 1967.
